rationale: Lycopolitan ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ; Crum: 'reveal, uncover.' Functions as synonym of ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ. Used four times on this page as the verb for the Father's eschatological self-disclosure of his face upon all the gods, and for the apostles' commissioned act of revealing what has happened and what shall happen.

Lycopolitan reflex of ⲡϩⲟ 'face,' with regular ⲍ for ϩ. ⲡⲉϩⲍⲟ 'his face' (line 22) is the same root with possessive prefix. Used in Manichaean cosmology of the Father's face/visage that shall be revealed upon all the gods at the consummation.
Lycopolitan reflex of ϩⲱⲃ 'work, matter, business.' Standard Coptic word — surprising it is not yet in the accumulated vocabulary.
Lycopolitan causative ⲧⲉ-ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'cause to add to,' with directional ⲁ- 'unto.' Standard Coptic verb of augmentation/addition.
Lycopolitan ⲡⲱⲣⲭ = Sahidic ⲡⲱⲣϫ 'separate, divide.' With ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' = the act of cosmic separation/distinction.
Standard Coptic ⲧⲁⲩⲟ 'utter, send forth, proclaim.' Used here of the apostles' commissioned act of declaration concerning the first cosmogonic moment and the things to come.
Lycopolitan ϩⲁ-ⲧⲉ-ϩⲏ 'before, in front, beforehand.' Standard adverbial expression of priority in time.
